name: Attractor Production AI Checklist
description: Evidence-based controls for moving an AI feature from prototype to production.

controls.title: Defined user need and outcome
controls.description: The feature solves a specific user problem with a measurable outcome.
controls.guidance: Name the user, decision or task, current baseline, intended change, and explicit non-goals.

controls.title: Human fallback and boundaries
controls.description: Users know the feature's limits and have a safe path when it cannot help.
controls.guidance: Define abstention, escalation, override, and user-facing disclosure behavior.

controls.title: Data provenance and permission
controls.description: Training, evaluation, retrieval, and prompt data have known sources and permitted uses.
controls.guidance: Record source, license or lawful basis, permitted purpose, retention, and material limitations.

controls.title: Representative data quality checks
controls.description: Data quality and coverage are measured against relevant production traffic.
controls.guidance: Check missingness, duplication, freshness, language, segments, and known blind spots.

controls.title: Evaluation success criteria
controls.description: Quality dimensions, datasets, metrics, thresholds, and regressions are defined before launch.
controls.guidance: Include task quality, harmful failure modes, important slices, and baseline comparison.

controls.title: Automated regression gate
controls.description: Changes run repeatable evaluations with explicit release thresholds.
controls.guidance: Pin inputs and scorer versions, surface case-level failures, and block material regression.

controls.title: Production quality sampling
controls.description: A privacy-safe sample of real interactions is reviewed for emerging failures.
controls.guidance: Define sampling, redaction, reviewer calibration, cadence, and issue routing.

controls.title: AI threat model
controls.description: Threats from untrusted inputs, tools, data sources, and generated outputs are documented.
controls.guidance: Cover prompt injection, data exfiltration, insecure output use, abuse, and supply-chain risk.

controls.title: Least-privilege tool boundaries
controls.description: Model-triggered tools and actions use explicit authorization and minimum privileges.
controls.guidance: Validate parameters, separate tenants, require confirmation for consequential actions, and log decisions.

controls.title: Personal data flow and retention
controls.description: Personal and sensitive data flows, processors, retention, and deletion are understood.
controls.guidance: Minimize collection and document prompts, logs, caches, vendors, residency, retention, and deletion.

controls.title: User transparency and controls
controls.description: Users receive appropriate notice and can exercise relevant data choices.
controls.guidance: Review disclosure, consent or lawful basis, access, correction, deletion, and opt-out paths.

controls.title: Timeouts, retries, and degradation
controls.description: External failures have bounded latency, safe retries, and a tested degraded mode.
controls.guidance: Set end-to-end timeouts, retry only safe operations, prevent retry storms, and test fallback.

controls.title: Capacity and dependency limits
controls.description: Traffic, quotas, concurrency, and provider limits are tested against expected load.
controls.guidance: Document load assumptions, rate limits, circuit breakers, and provider outage behavior.

controls.title: Privacy-safe AI traces
controls.description: Operators can connect user outcomes to versions, retrieval, model calls, latency, and cost.
controls.guidance: Capture correlation IDs and version metadata while redacting secrets and unnecessary personal data.

controls.title: Service and quality alerts
controls.description: Alerts cover availability, latency, errors, spend, and important quality signals.
controls.guidance: Make alerts actionable, owned, tested, and linked to a runbook.

controls.title: Unit economics and budget
controls.description: Expected and worst-case costs are measured per useful user outcome.
controls.guidance: Include model, retrieval, infrastructure, retries, review labor, and traffic growth.

controls.title: Spend guardrails
controls.description: Unexpected use or loops cannot create unbounded spend.
controls.guidance: Set request, tenant, and global budgets with alerts and graceful limits.

controls.title: Cross-functional launch review
controls.description: Product, engineering, security, privacy, and operations accept residual risks.
controls.guidance: Record open risks, mitigations, owners, due dates, rollout stages, and rollback criteria.

controls.title: AI incident runbook
controls.description: Responders can contain harmful output, data exposure, abuse, dependency failure, and runaway cost.
controls.guidance: Include detection, severity, containment, evidence preservation, communication, and recovery.

controls.title: Operational ownership
controls.description: Named teams own service health, quality, data, security, cost, and decommissioning.
controls.guidance: Document primary and backup owners, escalation paths, review cadence, and lifecycle decisions.
